title: foundry plan.json, version 1
description: The plan the architect writes to <foundry dir>/plan.json: the seam between the architect, the foreman and the hooks. See adr/0001-design-phase.md, section 8.

goal.description: The run's goal, as the owner gave it.

architecture.description: Repo-relative path of the architecture doc, as recorded in <repo>/.claude/foundry.json.

approval.description: "owner" exactly when some crew is in wave 0; otherwise "auto".

approvedAt.description: When the owner approved the plan, as an ISO 8601 date-time, or null before approval. While approval is "owner" and this is null, the approval gate refuses every lead.

agentCap.description: The most agents the plan may estimate in total. Default 40, from <repo>/.claude/foundry.json.

maxParallelCrews.description: The most crews that may be running at once. Default 4, from <repo>/.claude/foundry.json.

crews.description: One entry per crew. Crews in a wave beyond maxParallelCrews start in this order as running ones merge.

slug.description: The crew's name, and the name of its foundry:lead. Limited to the characters safeName in hooks/register.ts keeps, so report folders match the slug.

wave.description: The wave the crew runs in. Wave 0 holds the change work and merges before any other wave starts.

verdict.description: The architect's verdict for the crew's work. "design" marks a wave-0 design crew.

modules.description: Module names from the architecture doc's module map.

owns.description: Path globs the crew owns. No two crews may own the same file.

doneCheck.description: The command that proves the crew is done, runnable with the crew's own access.

doneCheckProved.description: Whether the architect ran doneCheck once while planning.

estAgents.description: Estimated agent count for the crew.

status.description: Set by the foreman as crews start and merge. The hooks only read it.
